description: Verify that DUT-emit UDP datagram carries the caller-specified Destination Port (RFC 768 'User Interface' MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
User-interface mirror of FIELDS_02. The send primitive must carry the caller's dst_port to the wire — anything else means the message reaches the wrong endpoint.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: send-UDP request via the user interface (dst_port = K)

2. Observation:
   • DUT → Tester: UDP datagram
     - dst_port == K   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted UDP carries dst_port = K.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_dst_port — DUT emitted UDP with a different dst_port
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any UDP within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted UDP carries the requested dst_port — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_dst_port: DUT emitted UDP with the wrong user-interface dst_port
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT-originated UDP within the listen window
